premise: Starfish is 'it' at hide and seek in the rock pool and finds everyone, even behind her: she has a tiny eye at the tip of each arm.
inspiration: The trickster-who-can't-be-fooled folk motif (the all-seeing guardian), made small and true: the 'magic' is how starfish are made.
lesson: Everyone has their own surprising way of seeing the world.
learning: A starfish has a tiny eye at the tip of each arm.

en-US.title: Eyes on the Tips
en-US.text: [excited] Hide and seek in the rock pool! {starfish:enter} Starfish was counting. {starfish:pulse} One, two, three, four, five! {shrimp:enter} Shrimp {sfx:dart} zipped behind a stone. {fish:enter} Little Fish hid right behind Starfish, {fish:go to starfish} at her back. {fish:face happy} [whispers] She'll never see me here. [short pause] But Starfish lifted one arm {starfish:live} and waved it about. {starfish:face happy} Found you, Little Fish! {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} How? Then she pointed another arm at the stone. And you, Shrimp! {shrimp:live} Shrimp twitched her feelers and flicked her tail. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] How do you DO that? {starfish:sparkle} Starfish giggled. At the tip of every arm I have a tiny eye. Five arms, five little eyes. They can't see much… but they can see you! {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} My turn to count, said Little Fish. And this time he hid… right in front of her. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

es-ES.title: Ojos en las puntas
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Al escondite en la charca! {starfish:enter} Estrella contaba. {starfish:pulse} ¡Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco! {shrimp:enter} Gamba {sfx:dart} se escondió de un salto detrás de una piedra. {fish:enter} Pececito se puso detrás de Estrella, {fish:go to starfish} justo a su espalda. {fish:face happy} [whispers] Aquí no me ve. [short pause] Pero Estrella levantó un brazo {starfish:live} y lo movió de aquí para allá. {starfish:face happy} ¡Te pillé, Pececito! {fish:face surprised} {fish:wobble} ¿Cómo? Luego apuntó otro brazo hacia la piedra. ¡Y a ti, Gamba! {shrimp:live} Gamba movió las antenas y sacudió la cola. {shrimp:face surprised} [curious] ¿Cómo lo HACES? {starfish:sparkle} Estrella se rió. En la punta de cada brazo tengo un ojito. Cinco brazos, cinco ojitos. No ven mucho… ¡pero a vosotros sí! {fish:face happy} {shrimp:face happy} Ahora cuento yo, dijo Pececito. Y esta vez se escondió… justo delante de ella. {starfish:hearts} [laughs]

dart.prompt: a tiny quick splash of a small creature darting through a shallow rock pool, realistic
